defensiveAbilities.name: Cold Lethargy
defensiveAbilities.description: Although a basidirond is immune to cold damage, any effect that deals cold damage causes it to become Slowed 1 for 1d4 rounds. During this time, it cannot use its Hallucinogenic Cloud or basidirond spores.

offensiveAbilities.name: Basidirond Spores
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d8 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d10 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 1d12 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Hallucinogenic Cloud
offensiveAbilities.description:
The basidirond releases a cloud of invisible spores in a 20ft Emanation. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save or experience powerful hallucinations as long as it remains in the cloud, plus an additional 1d4 rounds after leaving the area. A creature must attempt a new save each round it remains within the area. The cloud persists for 5 rounds unless dispersed before then by a strong wind. Each hallucinating creature rolls 1d6 each round to determine what it hallucinates that round.

  1. The target is sinking in quicksand. It falls Prone and spends 1 action on its next turn flailing its limbs as if attempting to swim.
  2. The target is attacked by a swarm of spiders. It spends 2 actions on its next turn attacking the floor with a melee weapon (drawing a weapon if needed). It is Off-Guard against all attacks.
  3. An item the target is holding turns into a viper. The target Release the item and spends its next turn fleeing from it.
  4. The target is suffocating. It holds its breath and is Stunned 3.
  5. The target shrinks to 1/10 its normal size. For 1 round it is Slowed 2 and Enfeebled 4, and takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speed.
  6. The target is melting. It drops everything it's holding and becomes Slowed 2 and Clumsy 4 for 1 round.
